learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.

observations.prediction: Selected stays at10% when four stop searching and locked it in. Formula already visible: looking divided by working plus looking; nonlookers excluded.
observations.exploration: Four stop looking gave90 working,6 looking,4 outside,rate6.25%. Four find jobs gave94 working,6 looking,rate6%, retaining both comparison summaries. Slider10 withdrawal reset jobs90,looking0,outside10,rate0%.
observations.reveal: Corrected falls; explains numerator and denominator shrink for withdrawal versus jobs increasing in job-finding case. Two similar rates tell different stories; job count distinguishes. Toy town100 caveat.
observations.visual: Inline screenshot inspected at jobs preset: counted box with94 filled and6 outlined dots, empty nonlooking box,rate6%,jobs94 and both comparison summaries legible. Trust5/5 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
